title: ウィーアー! (We Are! — ONE PIECE Opening Theme)
description:
The original opening theme of the ONE PIECE anime, first broadcast in October 1999 and beloved for over 25 years. Performed by きただにひろし (Kitadani Hiroshi) — this was his debut single as a solo artist. Lyrics by 藤林聖子 (Fujibayashi Seiko), music by 田中公平 (Tanaka Kohei), who composed much of the ONE PIECE soundtrack.

The song captures the spirit of the series perfectly: chasing dreams, gathering friends, setting sail without a compass, and treating every crisis as an opportunity. It became one of the most iconic anime openings ever made, widely known among fans in Japan and internationally. Kitadani performed it live at the 2023 ONE PIECE Film: Red concert event, drawing enormous emotional response.

For learners: Strong N4 material with adventure and motivational vocabulary throughout. Key words: ありったけの夢 (all the dreams one has), かき集め (to gather up), 捜し物 (something one is searching for), 羅針盤 (compass), 渋滞 (congestion / traffic jam — used metaphorically as 'only causes delays'), 熱にうかされ (feverish, carried away by heat/excitement), 舵をとる (to take the helm), ホコリかぶった (dust-covered), 伝説 (legend), バイオリズム (biorhythm), ピンチ (pinch / tight spot), 自意識過剰 (self-conscious / excessive ego), しみったれた夜 (a dreary night). The mix of formal and colloquial Japanese is typical of adventure anime and good practice for real spoken Japanese.
